reuse.why: Adds the rule to the existing getCategoriesForBulkBudgetAction selection and reuses the shared tag matcher, though it borrows the AQL-oriented makeTagAqlRegex where extractTagsFromText is the tree's plain-text tag parser.

duplication.why: The #fixed check is written once in the shared selection; no logic is copied.

placement.why: The rule sits in the bulk-action selection in budget/actions.ts, but is bolted on as a .then filter after the SQL rather than integrated with the other exclusions.

scope.why: Only the selection function and one test are changed.

maintainability.why: copyPreviousMonth, a month-wide action, does not use getCategoriesForBulkBudgetAction and is left without the #fixed exclusion, so the rule is applied unevenly; the declared return type also no longer describes the selected row.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The change itself goes through getCategoriesForBulkBudgetAction; copyPreviousMonth's pre-existing own filtering is left untouched rather than routed through it.

one_place.where: The #fixed rule lands in getCategoriesForBulkBudgetAction (setZero, setLastMonthSpending, setBulkNMonthAvg), but copyPreviousMonth filters budgetData with its own hidden checks and never applies the rule.
